row.name: Astrana Health Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=35 breakdowns=1 bursts_in_base=3 giveback=1.24 tightness=0.93 base_volume_vs_leg=0.69 base_volume_vs_avg=0.89
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 35 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base gave back 1.24 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 4.4% vs its 20-SMA, -1.1% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)
first leg of 15.4% in 10 sessions: his '15% plus in 10 days or less'

claude.reason: Two hard checklist failures drive this down: C fails because the base is 35 sessions (nearly double the 20-session ceiling) with a giveback of 1.24x the leg and three bursts inside the base, and VOL fails because volume on the signal day was only 74% of the 50-session average when a base over 21 sessions requires at least 1.5x that average. The chart confirms the shaded base region is wide and choppy with multiple overlapping bars and visible pushes and pullbacks across roughly seven weeks, consistent with a loose, extended consolidation rather than a tight orderly one.
claude.key_risk: The base gave back more than the entire prior leg gain and contains three internal bursts, meaning any follow-through is fighting a heavily overhead-supplied, well-distributed structure.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the signal day's close of 37.55 or if volume in the first 30 minutes is tracking below the prior session's pace, confirming continued distribution.
